plugins_comment: Named one by one because the default glob resolves plugins by scanning a flat node_modules, which pnpm does not give it: under pnpm the run starts with no runner and no checker loaded, and the only symptom is an 'unknown config option' warning for the runner's own settings.
mutate_comment: Every source file that ships, the command included. cli/main.ts is reachable only from the subprocess test the runner excludes, so it always reads as no coverage.
mutator_comment: StringLiteral is excluded because most of its survivors are warning and error text, which most tests do not read word for word.
